description: UPDATE a Robinhood Chain first-touch subscription (PATCH — this writes). CAREFUL: `filters` is a WHOLE-OBJECT REPLACE, not a merge — send the complete filter set you want, because any key you omit is removed (that is the only way to express 'drop this filter'). Read the current filters with rhc_first_touch_subscriptions_get first. is_active:false pauses without deleting. Pass null for name or webhook_url to clear them. Tier: ULTRA+.

filters.description: REPLACES the stored filter object wholesale — omitted keys are dropped, not kept

kol.description: Only first touches by this KOL EVM wallet (0x, 40 hex)

max_mc_usd.description: Maximum token market cap — must be >= min_mc_usd

min_first_buy_eth.description: Minimum size of the first buy in ETH

min_mc_usd.description: Minimum token market cap at the first touch

strategy.description: Only KOLs with this trading strategy

is_active.description: false pauses the subscription without deleting it

name.description: New label, or null to clear

webhook_url.description: New HTTPS webhook URL, or null to clear

name: rhc_first_touch_subscriptions_update
